summary: Implements Utaku Elite Guard's army-scoped Battle-Maiden boost (issue #170), the third and last of the aggregate/group Force effects sequenced with Senior Infantry Legion (#162, PR #163) and Ashigaru Elite (#166, PR #172). New ArmyBattleMaidenBoost(card) is the same static 'boost others' shape as Senior Infantry Legion, but keyword-based (Battle Maiden) rather than type-based (Follower), and army-scoped (every OTHER Battle-Maiden card the owner controls at the same battlefield, not confined to one unit) rather than unit-scoped -- counts other same-owner same-province Zone.Battlefield Personalities with Effect=='boost-battle-maidens-in-army', excluding the card itself. Plugged into both PersonalityForce and FollowerForce. Shared-file note: all changed files are within L5R.Core (rules engine) and its test suite, plus docs/ROADMAP.md -- a single rules-lane primitive change; no UI/client files touched. This is a rebuild of PR #171 (originally stacked on mdornbrook/164-ashigaru-elite-boost) as a fresh branch off main -- that base branch is superseded now that Ashigaru Elite merged via a rebuilt PR (#172), so this diff was extracted and reapplied cleanly with no conflicts.
validation: New ArmyBattleMaidenBoostPrimitive test: the guard does not boost itself; a Battle Maiden Personality in a different unit (same army) is boosted; a Battle Maiden Follower is boosted; a non-Battle-Maiden card, a Battle Maiden not at this battlefield, and the enemy's own Battle Maiden are all unaffected; two guards in one army grant each other but never themselves. Full suite: 102/102 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes (13/13 AI, 5/5 server integration, 4/4 client transport integration).
remaining: Infrastructure only -- no published card needs it yet (Utaku Elite Guard is not imported). This closes out the three-card aggregate/group Force effects sequence the user specced in one message; no further card in this sequence is outstanding.
